overnightRisk: Thin Sunday-night / early-Asia liquidity is where the sharpest air-pocket moves happen, and BTC sits mid-range (~$64,300) with a validated downside magnet at $62,200 and thin liquidity between it and the $63,700 floor — a flush through $63,700/$63,000 could travel quickly to $62,200. Specific catalysts into the overnight and Monday: (1) Monday Jul 27 US spot-BTC-ETF flow print — whether the ~$465M two-day outflow was a one-off pause or the start of a broader reversal; a second heavy outflow day is the main downside trigger. (2) Mega-cap earnings week (AAPL/MSFT/META) sets risk appetite and QQQ, which is already at a trailing-monthly low (-1.12% Friday). (3) The stalling CLARITY Act vote (Polymarket ~34% for 2026 passage) is a crypto-specific headline risk. (4) US10Y ~4.65% and DXY ~101.5 (Friday carry) — a Monday risk-off tape pressures BTC. Upside surprise risk is smaller but real: a clean close >$65,406 that holds would flip the range. No resting stop is armed up here (price is far above the $63,000 reduce level); the plan is to buy a gap-down toward $62,200 with the reserved ~$6.6 powder, and to scale the core down only on a 4H close below $63,000.
